stem: Why did President Thomas Jefferson approve the negotiations that led to the Louisiana Purchase?

options.label: A
options.text: He wanted to settle boundary disputes with Great Britain.

options.label: B
options.text: He wanted to take control of the Mississippi River.

options.label: C
options.text: He wanted to obtain land to limit Russian colonization.

options.label: D
options.text: He wanted to take control of the Appalachian Mountains.
